recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy surrealist composition featuring a central glass bottle or vessel exploding into a chaotic spray of liquid, glass shards, and floating musical notes, set against a warm, dark gradient background with large, soft-focus spherical elements.
coreVisualRelationships: The central explosion radiates outward from the middle-right toward the bottom-left.
Large, out-of-focus golden spheres frame the central action, creating depth.
Musical notes are integrated into the liquid spray as if they are physical matter.
The typography acts as a rigid horizontal frame for the fluid, organic central chaos.
coreInvariants: Warm color palette of gold, amber, and deep brown.
High-contrast metallic highlights on glass and liquid.
Dynamic sense of frozen motion in the explosion.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The exploding vessel is the central subject, scaled to occupy the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, concentrated point of the explosion in the upper-right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal spray from the top-right down to the bottom-left, bounded by the text at the top and bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep brown and purple-toned negative space in the corners provides breathing room for the complex central detail.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep amber and golden yellow for the primary light and objects.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark chocolate brown and muted purple for the background shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for specular highlights on glass and liquid edges.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the glowing central objects and the dark, low-saturation background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and metallic golds

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospaced use of a single high-contrast serif for both title and artist name.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and elegant verticality.
Provides the necessary weight and sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surrealist airbrush painting of a glass bottle shattering in mid-air, with liquid and musical notes spraying diagonally across the frame. Use a warm amber and dark brown color palette with large out-of-focus golden spheres in the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in a white, high-contrast condensed serif font at the very top and bottom edges of the frame with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Does the explosion feel dynamic and diagonal?
Are the highlights on the glass bright white?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is garbled or overlapping the main subject.
Check that the musical notes look integrated into the liquid.
Verify the background spheres have a soft, bokeh-like blur.
Confirm the color palette remains strictly warm-toned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist airbrush explosion + high-contrast condensed serif framing + warm amber/gold palette.
